content:
priya: FYI opening PR to consolidate per-model ConfigMaps into a single keyed ConfigMap in the infra namespace. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4829 Need eyes on Terraform + kustomize overlays. Plan to canary tomorrow 06:00 PT. @jamie @marco please review when you can. :wave:

jamie: quick Q — what's the rollback strategy if runtime chokes on parsing keys? :thinking:

priya: rollback plan:
- revert the TF change and re-apply (forces old CM back)
- have reconcile controller temporarily ignore the new key format via feature flag
But prefer canary: apply only to ns with label "cm-rollout=canary" for 10 models first.

alex: making sure per-model secrets stay untouched, right? this only changes the central configmap structure.

marco: correct. secrets remain per-namespace. runtime change required: read config by key path `data[model_name]` and jsondecode.
I'll open a companion PR in runtime shortly.

elaine: paste terraform snippet? want to sanity-check encoding.

priya: sure, here's the crux of the TF change:

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_config_map" "per_model_unified" {
  metadata {
    name      = "models-config"
    namespace = var.infra_namespace
  }

  data = { for k, v in var.per_model_configs : k => jsonencode(v) }
}
```

jamie: left comments on PR about escaping keys with "/" and invalid chars. added a unit test for key sanitization.

infra-bot: CI pipeline — PR #4829: unit tests ✅, kustomize render ✅, gated_apply job queued for canary label.

sre-oncall: 👍 ping me when canary starts, I'll watch tail latency and error budget dashboards.

priya: thanks all — I'll address comments and post a rollout checklist (including smoke test commands and dashboard links) before canary. tagging @alex for docs update on config format.

alex: will update docs and notify customers if anything changes for dedicated customers.

marco: opening runtime PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2301 — it adds `models_config_key` parse and feature flag `unified_cm_v1`.

priya: perfect. last_message: will coordinate canary window with SRE, ETA tomorrow 06:00 PT. Anyone object? :eyes:

jamie: no objections.

elaine: all good from my side.

sre-oncall: standing by.
